images.author: Jack French
images.why: 2048×1365. Clear-day aerial showing Logan in the foreground; crop around Logan, with Mount Saint Elias in the right background.

images.author: Gerald Holdsworth
images.why: Classic southeast view of the massif. Resolution fallback only: 975×639, below the preferred 2000-pixel long side.

images.author: Sergey Pesterev
images.why: 3043×2036. Commons featured photograph of the classic Amboseli view, with snow-covered Kibo above acacia-dotted savanna.

images.author: Ninaras
images.why: 5860×3907. Kilimanjaro with elephants in Amboseli; ample resolution for a crop combining the summit and wildlife.

images.author: Lafleursauvage
images.why: 4592×3056. Another classic Amboseli perspective, offering substantial resolution for a summit-centred 9:10 crop.

images.author: Meevansjay
images.why: 4032×3024. Early-morning Amboseli view; the 4:3 original requires less horizontal cropping than wider alternatives.

images.author: Eric Gilbertson
images.why: 2040×1536. Photograph from 2024 showing Cristóbal Colón on the left and Simón Bolívar on the right; crop toward Colón. Permission verified by Wikimedia VRT.

images.author: Sylvain Perret
images.why: 2560×1920. Established southern view with Colón on the left. Fallback: Commons flags image quality, so sharpness is weaker than preferred.

images.author: JukoFF
images.why: 3008×2000. Classic northern view of Elbrus, with its recognisable twin summits; the uncropped original provides useful framing room.

images.author: Dmitry A. Mottl
images.why: 5472×3648. Recognisable mountain view from Cheget, with ample resolution for a near-square crop.

images.author: SKas
images.why: 4320×3081. Both summits shown from the southeast; recognised as a Commons valued image for this specific viewpoint.

images.author: Ted.ns
images.why: 5440×3627. Commons featured photograph from the road toward Dzhily-Su; strong landscape context, although Elbrus is farther away.

images.author: oliwok
images.why: 3648×5472. Featured night photograph of the Milky Way over Elbrus; portrait alternative, with less emphasis on summit detail.
